private_notes.observations: This is Quarter 1, with no prior rate or allocation data. Meridian allocates more hours to lower-priced panel firms, may keep more work in-house when panel rates are high, and does not disclose its formula. Arden & Cole's fully loaded hourly cost is $200; profit is (rate − $200) × allocated hours. The panel relationship is expected to continue over many quarters.
private_notes.plan: Set a competitive rate that earns a positive margin while positioning Arden & Cole to attract meaningful hours and learn from the published panel rate card. Reassess in later quarters using competitors' rates and observed account outcomes; avoid pricing below cost.

private_notes.observations: No prior quarters or panel rates are available, so competitor pricing and Meridian’s allocation response are unknown.

private_notes.observations: No prior quarters or panel rates are available. Meridian allocates more hours to lower-rate firms, but may retain work in-house when panel rates are high. Our delivery cost is $200 per hour.
